links.outcome: Model AUROC/sensitivity versus SIRS, Shapiro Rule, physicians and GPT-5 for bacteremia prediction
links.effect: Cultryx outperformed all clinical heuristics (AUROC 0.810); SIRS specificity 41.2%; Shapiro sensitivity 70.2%; physicians with Fabre 95.7% sensitivity vs GPT-5 71.6%.
links.quote: In real-world benchmarking, Cultryx outperformed all clinical heuristics (AUROC 0.810).

screen.reason: Evaluates predictive ML (Cultryx) and LLM (GPT-5) for diagnostic stewardship/bacteremia prediction, specifically assessing the operational impact of calibrating the ML model to a strict 95% sensitivity operational threshold for deferring blood cultures.

primary.practice: calibrated decision threshold targeting high sensitivity
